problem_keywords: Echo in open-plan office breakout areas
desire for geometric ceiling features without visible perimeter framing.
high concrete ceilings causing reverberation over collaborative tables
not_for: not load-bearing (cannot hold downlights or sprinklers)
not_for): Not a continuous ceiling tile system
use_cases: When customer requests modern geometric ceiling clouds to treat reverberation over a specific zone (e.g. boardroom table, reception lounge). The higher the suspension drop (up to 800mm), the higher the low-frequency sound absorption (1.4 Sabins).
